authorization.quote: If you agree with Claude, I accept them
authorization.provenance: User to Codex after supplying Claude’s sixty-second audit. Codex agrees with the no-defect verdict and accepts exactly the three reviewed slots at their disclosed scope.

scope: Accept S1-LL08-a [r6], S1-LL22-b [control] and S1-LL23-a [generated] at STAGE1-1A-R2 scope; registration/R6, initial generated build binding and V8 fatal diagnostics. Nine nonallocating leaf functions, 24 calls (23 distinct).
exclusions: No general B ABI, target heap, image construction, GC, closure, ordinary Lisp arity conditions or browser stack qualification.
Runtime globals schema/accessors are required before the first generated global access; constant indexing before S1-LL10-a admits heap constants; coordinated heap/code construction remains 1E.
The runner-written leaf ABI schema is reviewed but is not a direct binding to the accepted B decision; add that binding when the generated ABI work expands.

scope_decisions.prior_question: Does “proceed with Stage 1” authorize Codex to author functional compiler changes in disposable clean U1 copies, with Claude reviewing before those changes enter the main checkout?
scope_decisions.prior_user_answer: Yes—Codex implements; Claude reviews before integration
scope_decisions.interpretation: The recorded answer authorizes the disposable-copy workflow. Retaining proposals under tests/wasm/stage1 is Codex’s implementation choice, not a verbatim user instruction.

scope_decisions.decision: Accept the reviewed registration in 1A. Preserve the full coordinated heap/code writer and loader as required 1E work. No Stage 1 inventory assertion is removed or weakened.
scope_decisions.rationale: This slice generates nonallocating leaves and no target heap. The adopted plan already assigns cross-dump and image loading to 1E.

scope_decisions.decision: Accept 1A’s ownership/addressing design and refusal boundary. Complete offsets/accessors before a generated kernel-global operation and constant indexing before heap constants in 1B/S1-LL10-a.
scope_decisions.rationale: The accepted leaf slice uses neither operation and refuses unsupported forms. These are explicit remaining implementation obligations, not completed tests.
